Messages.Author: Eric Tullis
Messages.Body:
Are prints of any of the card art available for purchase? I thought
someone mentioned this a week or two ago, but offered no details.

Thanks!
Eric

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Several of the artists sell prints of Jyhad and VTES art. You can find
information on how to contact these artists, and possibly which prints
they have available, by reading the ARtist Update in each issue of
the Duelist. Any Deckmaster artists who wants to be listed
there is.
